# Umbra

> Open-source Windows desktop widgets: small sandboxed web pages (HTML/CSS/JS in WebView2) pinned to the wallpaper by a C# .NET 10 host. Scriptable through `umbractl` and an MCP server, so AI agents can configure and build widgets.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/README.md): what Umbra is, install, settings, automation (CLI and MCP)
- [Widget SDK](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/docs/widget-sdk.md): complete widget reference (manifest, JavaScript API, sandbox, design rules)
- [Tutorial](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/docs/widgets/tutorial.md): your first widget in 10 minutes (new, dev, validate, pack, install, share)
- [Cookbook](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/docs/widgets/cookbook.md): recipes linked to real widgets (fetching, options, timers, notifications, commands, media, offline, games)
- [For browser-extension developers](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/docs/widgets/from-browser-extensions.md): manifest.json vs widget.json, permissions, storage, alarms, and the manifest field index by version
- Package format: a `.umbrawidget` is a zip with `widget.json` at its root (`umbractl pack`); `manifestVersion` (default 1) and `minUmbraVersion` in widget.json gate older apps
- [widget.json schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AmineChr54/umbra/main/schemas/widget.schema.json): JSON Schema for widget manifests
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): publish a widget by pull request
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): architecture, commands, security invariants for coding agents

## Examples

- [S&P 500 widget](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/tree/main/widgets/sp500): data fetching, options, SVG chart, animation
- [Pomodoro widget](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/tree/main/widgets/pomodoro): timers, saved state
- [Clock widget](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/tree/main/widgets/clock): offline widget with toggle options

## Automation

- [Control protocol](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/src/Umbra.Core/Protocol.cs): commands available over the per-user pipe
- [MCP server](https://github.com/AmineChr54/umbra/blob/main/src/Umbra.Cli/McpServer.cs): tool definitions for `umbractl mcp`
